name: CSC VLE TOOLS - upload to GitHub with VS Code
which_zip_to_upload: CSC_VLE_TOOLS_v31.zip (full version). Do NOT upload CSC_VLE_TOOLS_v31_standalone.zip; it is only for testing one tool at a time.

steps.title: Unzip the full version into a NEW folder
do: Extract to C:\Users\askro\Documents\CSC_V31 (a new, empty folder).
Open that folder: you should see index.html, assets, cat-pdf.html and many tools_*.html files directly inside (no extra folder in between).

steps.title: Open the Git repo folder in VS Code
do: Choose C:\Users\askro\Documents\CSC_VLE_TOOLS\CSC-VLE-TOOLS (the inner folder that contains the hidden .git folder).
If VS Code asks 'Do you trust the authors', choose Yes.

steps.title: Open the terminal and confirm it is the repo
steps.where: VS Code, menu Terminal > New Terminal
steps.expect: It prints 'On branch main' and 'Your branch is up to date with origin/main'. If it says 'not a git repository', you opened the wrong folder: go back to step 2.

steps.title: Copy the new files into the repo (nothing is deleted)
steps.expect: A summary table appears. 'FAILED' must be 0. Robocopy shows exit codes 1 to 7 for success, that is normal. Files that exist only in the repo are kept.

steps.title: Check what changed
steps.expect: A list of modified files (cat-*.html, index.html, assets/css/*.css, assets/js/site.js ...) and new files (CHANGES_v31.txt, UPLOAD_STEPS_VSCODE.json ...). You can also look at the Source Control icon (Ctrl+Shift+G).

steps.title: Commit with a message
commands: git commit -m "v31: header and sidebar fixes, new right sidebar, review fixes"
steps.expect: 'N files changed'. If Git asks who you are, run the two lines in 'first_time_setup' below and repeat this step.

steps.title: Push to GitHub
steps.expect: The last lines look like 'abc1234..def5678  main -> main'. If a sign-in window opens, sign in to GitHub and the push continues.

steps.title: Check the live site
do: Open https://github.com/CSC-VLE-TOOLS-DESK/CSC-VLE-TOOLS and check the latest commit time.
Wait 1 to 2 minutes (see the Actions tab if the site is still building).
Open your live site and press Ctrl+F5. On a phone, close the tab and open it again.
Check: the header shows all buttons including Theme; both sidebars float with a gap; the right 'New Tools' panel is violet; open 3 or 4 tools.

troubleshooting.fix: You are in the wrong folder. In the terminal run: cd C:\Users\askro\Documents\CSC_VLE_TOOLS\CSC-VLE-TOOLS and then git status.
The online copy has newer changes. Run: git pull --rebase   and then: git push

troubleshooting.problem: git push asks for a password
troubleshooting.fix: GitHub no longer accepts account passwords. Use the sign-in window that opens (Git Credential Manager) or a Personal Access Token.

troubleshooting.problem: Site looks old after the push
troubleshooting.fix: Wait 2 minutes, then Ctrl+F5. All pages now load files as ?v=31, so old files should not be mixed. Check the Actions tab for a failed build.

troubleshooting.problem: A tool says 'This tool failed to load'
troubleshooting.fix: A file was not uploaded. Upload the WHOLE assets folder (js, css, maps, kids) and all .html files, not only some of them. The message names the missing file.
The assets/kids folder was not copied. Run step 4 again.

troubleshooting.problem: I pushed by mistake and want to go back
troubleshooting.fix: Run: git log --oneline   then: git revert HEAD   then: git push

notes: Each version zip contains the WHOLE site, so you can always repeat steps 1 to 8 with a newer zip.
robocopy without /MIR never deletes files from the repo, so old files stay; delete them by hand in VS Code if you want them gone.
Back up the repo folder (copy it) before big changes if you like.
